purpose: Choose a boolean option with an independent mixed-state presentation and native hidden form input.

decisions.scope: Sufficient source-bound React reference description; no certification of every consumer or native platform.
decisions.normalizedProtocol: SCXML events project source callbacks/native interactions. Send entries document the observed callback and are not additional DOM dispatches. The adapter supplies isCanceled after the source callback transaction. Controlled SET_VALUE/SET_CHECKED props remain authoritative.
decisions.visual: Native FIG observations and DTCG values remain visual truth. React styles may differ; no unverified pixel equivalence is assumed.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: The source span role control has a 16px square and14px indicator. Explicit caller field layout owns8px label spacing; this wrapper is not falsely attributed to upstream. Checked/mixed/disabled/error reflect actual native/ARIA/data attributes. No separate native mixed specimen is present in the pinned page; mixed is supported by the React API. Mixed state retains checked=false as separate authority; a deliberately chosen half-indicator-width CSS minus replaces the source check glyph for the source-supported indeterminate presentation, without changing the native event/value contract.
